meta.vantage: github-hosted ubuntu runner to the ap-southeast-2 staging stack; budgets derived here are not comparable to numbers measured from any other vantage

queue-switch-first.note: Bootstrap: report-only until a soak of at least 15 runs characterises the spread of the per-run max. Lock at worst observed run max times 1.25, rounded up to 25ms, then flip to error. Ratchet target once the listing cache lands: this is the cache-miss arm.

queue-switch-subsequent.note: Bootstrap: report-only until soaked. Ratchet target once the listing cache lands: this is the cache-hit arm and should fall furthest.

tab-switch-first.note: Bootstrap: report-only until soaked. Cache-miss arm of the To-Read/Read switch.

tab-switch-subsequent.note: Bootstrap: report-only until soaked. Cache-hit arm of the To-Read/Read switch.

assign-to-queue.note: Bootstrap: report-only until soaked. Ratchet target when the assign response becomes an out-of-band fragment instead of a full reader re-render.

open-article.note: Bootstrap: report-only until soaked. Ratchet target when visible cards are prefetched; expect responseStart to collapse on a prefetch hit.

back-to-queue.note: Bootstrap: report-only until soaked. Ratchet target when the reader exit becomes instant.
